by the owner's recorded exception for muted text, the one light mode takes too, as the next gray up is secondary's own step. So people read a hint in a menu as well as on the page, because text keeps the AAA floor (accessibility.definition) and the neutral ramp has no step between muted and secondary (color.definition).

pick: radius.4: We use a 4px corner for badges and checkboxes in order to give marks a role of their own, apart from the 6px controls. The smallest radius does this by keeping a clear rectangle around a word or a check. So a status never looks like a pill button, because badges get their own corner (shape.roles) and the brand is clear (brand.q1).
